translation: Non-toxic. It mainly warms the center, sends qi downward, [treats] vexation and fullness, short breath, damage to the viscera, cough, stops thirst, frees the channels and vessels, frees blood qi, and resolves the poison of the hundred drugs; it is the essence of the nine soils, and harmonizes and settles the seventy-two kinds of stone and the one thousand two hundred kinds of herbs. One name is Migan [蜜甘], one name is Meicao [美草], one name is Micao [蜜草], one name is [it grows in] Hexi Jisha Mountain and Shangjun.
